resources.string: See what uses space and remove local downloads
Review local app data and remove downloads without changing your account or server.
Storage is low. Free space to keep downloads and syncing reliable.
These actions never delete subscriptions, read or starred state, credentials, or server-side data. Article metadata and full text remain protected.
%1$d articles · %2$d feeds · %3$d stored bodies · %4$d reading positions
This removes saved original web pages from this device. Article metadata, full article content, reading state, subscriptions, credentials, and server data stay unchanged. Pages can be saved again.
This removes downloaded article images from this device. Article text, reading state, subscriptions, credentials, and server data stay unchanged. Images can be downloaded again.
This removes downloaded neural voice files. The system voice, voice settings, articles, reading state, subscriptions, credentials, and server data stay unchanged. Voices can be downloaded again.

This removes the on-device AI model and any partial download. Article data, cloud model settings, reading state, subscriptions, credentials, and server data stay unchanged. The model can be downloaded again.
This removes temporary files and the WebView/image-sharing cache. Articles, reading state, downloaded models, subscriptions, credentials, and server data stay unchanged.
Could not measure local storage. Try again.
Cleanup did not finish. Some files may remain; your articles, reading state, subscriptions, credentials, and server data were not changed.
